name: Termux
shortDescription: A terminal emulator and Linux environment for Android, with package management and shell tools.
description: Termux provides an Android terminal environment and a Linux package collection. It is useful for command-line workflows, scripting, learning Linux fundamentals and running supported packages on a compatible Android device.
features: Supports shell scripting and common command-line workflows
safetyNote: Install from the official project sources and review the release notes for your Android version.

name: Spam SMS
shortDescription: An SMS testing tool designed to send multiple text messages for authorized testing.
description: Spam SMS is described as an SMS pumper application designed to send multiple text messages. Use only with authorized recipients and compatible services, and avoid unsolicited messaging or message flooding.
features: Designed for sending multiple SMS messages
safetyNote: Use only for authorized testing with consent. Unsolicited bulk messaging may violate laws, carrier policies, or service terms.

name: Magisk
shortDescription: A powerful Android rooting solution with systemless root access and module support.
description: Magisk is an open-source rooting solution for Android that provides systemless modifications, root access management and support for modules that customize device functionality.
features: Manage root permissions with Superuser access controls
Modify Android without directly altering the system partition
safetyNote: Rooting may reduce device security, affect banking apps and cause boot problems. Download Magisk only from the official project sources and verify APK authenticity.

name: Third Eye - Smart Video Recorder
shortDescription: Record videos on Android while the screen is off.
description: Third Eye is an Android video recording app that lets you record videos while the screen is completely off. It supports front and rear cameras, multiple video resolutions, and recording status notifications.
features: Record videos while the screen is off
Multiple video resolutions including HD and Full HD
Recording time limit and repeat recording options
safetyNote: Use camera and microphone permissions responsibly, respect privacy, and comply with local recording laws.
